title: Venture Global, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-10
summary: Venture Global subsidiary Calcasieu Pass Funding, LLC closed a $1.75 billion senior secured term loan B facility on April 10, 2026, maturing April 10, 2033. Proceeds will be used to redeem preferred equity interests held by Stonepeak Bayou Holdings II LP, pay associated costs, and fund working capital and general corporate purposes. The loan bears interest at Term SOFR plus an agreed margin and is secured by a first-priority lien on substantially all borrower assets.
key_points: Calcasieu Pass Funding, LLC (indirect subsidiary of Venture Global) closed $1,750,000,000 Term Loan B Facility on April 10, 2026
Loan matures April 10, 2033; principal may be repaid after six months without premium or penalty (subject to breakage fees)
Interest rate: Term SOFR plus agreed margin, or Base Rate plus agreed margin
Proceeds used to redeem preferred equity interests issued to Stonepeak Bayou Holdings II LP in full
Security: first-priority lien on substantially all borrower assets and equity interests
Credit agreement contains customary representations, warranties, and affirmative/negative covenants
